_comment: Fast Lane plan Sec.7 (2026-08-01): the staleness ledger that makes tiering safe instead of a way
to quietly skip checks. Granularity is the ENTRY POINT a human or agent actually invokes, not
every nested check-*.py -- run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 already enforces (via
run-script-inventory-check.ps1's orphaned-gate-checker rule) that no check-*.py is invoked by
nothing; this ledger tracks WHEN each entry point last ran, and every check nested inside an
entry point is covered transitively by that entry point's own run record.
Every entry point run-all-gates.ps1 knows about, plus every check named explicitly in Sec.4/Sec.6
of the Fast Lane plan (T0's model-editing checks, T1's canary checks, T3's release evidence),
MUST appear here -- enforced by check-cadence-coverage.py (wired into run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1).
maxStaleness values: 'every-run' (T0 -- re-evaluated on every invocation, staleness is meaningless),
'1-wave', '1-move', '7-days' (also read as any release/tag/publish action, whichever is sooner).
Rule (Sec.7.3.5): deadlines are only ever shortened, never extended, to make something pass.
General rule (QUAL-12/13/14, 2026-08-15): a gate with a `paths:` filter -- or no trigger at all
besides workflow_dispatch -- is DORMANT for every change outside that filter. This ledger only
tracks entry points that DO run somewhere; it cannot see a check that runs nowhere at all, which
is exactly the shape QUAL-12 (engine-support.yml, 15 merges with zero coverage, including the
commit that shipped BT-1's non-executable gradlew), QUAL-13 (manager-harness.yml's paths never
named NPDevRuntimeHost/**, the module the same workflow's own jobs boot against) and QUAL-14
(firstrun-harness's run-readme.sh, invoked by no workflow at all until this date) each were. If a
workflow protects an artifact (a release, an installer, a generated app), it needs a post-merge
or scheduled trigger as well -- a paths filter alone means the first time it runs may be the tag.
There is no NPDev_General doc named VERIFICATION-CADENCE.md; this file and its _comment array are
the closest durable, machine-adjacent home for this rule, so it lives here rather than in a new
process document (CLAUDE.md's doc-inventory gate bans those).

checks.description: The 4 model.schema.json copies stay semantically identical. Cheap enough to run on every edit.
npdev validate model against the specific model.json being edited. Context-dependent -- only runs (and only counts as overdue) when a -ModelPath was ever given; never-run is not blocking on its own.
gradlew :NPDevContract:dsl:test --tests <touched area>. Context-dependent -- only runs (and only counts as overdue) when a -DslTestFilter was ever given; never-run is not blocking on its own.

S4 Phase B: an ADR decision the owner accepted (opt-in, via a ```decision-check fenced block naming a file + required substring) still has live code behind it. Closes the gap ADR-0011 D4 exposed -- accepted in S2's own gate, recorded in the ADR, never implemented, found only by running the S3 codemod against real content. Starts with ADR-0011's D1-D4 only. 2026-08-23 (Wave 6 of the 2026-08-23 defect-remediation session): invokedBy corrected -- R4 Part C moved the underlying check from run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 to run-weekly-paperwork-checks.ps1, but this entry still named the old caller, so cadence_state.py could never see a fresh run recorded against reality; also wired the missing cadence_state.py record call into the check's real host.
Generate + build + boot npdev-canary (the ONE frozen T1 fixture, Sec.5) and run its REST smoke plan (health, one flow, one panel).
Every DSL feature detector has at least one corpus model exercising it.

S6 (drift A3): reads scripts/quality/twin-pair-registry.json's human-curated list of location pairs that must move together (e.g. the four-place chain for a new top-level model array field, both directions of pack-composition) and fails the moment any pair diverges. 2026-08-23 (Wave 6 of the 2026-08-23 defect-remediation session): this check ran (hosted by the knowledge gate, step [20/39]) on every gate pass, but nothing ever called cadence_state.py record for it, so this entry's maxStaleness could never be satisfied and it showed permanently OVERDUE no matter how often it actually ran. Wired the missing record call into run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 right where the check already executes.
A field/panel rename does not silently break a hand-written screen, discovered against whatever is currently built under the Build root.
dsl-conformance-max still emits cleanly (NPDevSamples/scripts/generate-sample-app.ps1 -SampleId dsl-conformance-max -NoAssembleFinalApp -- emission only, no build/boot).
run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 -- static instrument checks + all in-repo check-*.py, including the script-inventory rule that fails if any checker is hosted by no gate.
run-generator-gate.ps1 -- the codegen engine, including the full 30-model corpus.
run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 -- an assembled sample app + its test suite, including WmsOffice-class interaction surfaces.

W3.2 (2026-08-25 remediation plan / QUAL-32): run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1 -- kernelQualityGate (:kernel:test + all 36+ :adapters:*:test) from NPDevKernel's own Gradle root, then the coverage ratchet against the fresh aggregate. Closes the gap the kernel note in scripts/policy/coverage-baseline.json used to describe: kernelQualityGate existed as a real Gradle task invoked by nothing, so the recorded floor (73.0968) had drifted 10 points from a full-suite measurement (62.69) before anything noticed.

checks.description: S1 O1 (2026-08-03): the regression baseline for ConceptQueryPredicateCompiler/JdbcBusinessConceptStore's SQL pushdown at 100k rows -- all three read paths sub-second with real WHERE/LIMIT/GROUP BY in the emitted SQL, none streamed the full table through the JVM. LC-P0 fixed the architecture; nobody had run it at volume before this baseline. A baseline nobody re-measures is the SCREEN_TAXONOMY staleness failure again -- see __OutsideRepo/s1/scale-baseline-2026-08-03.txt for the full numbers.
